title: Leveraging ChatGPT's Multimodal Vision Capabilities to Rank Satellite Images by Poverty Level: Advancing Tools for Social Science Research
abstract: arXiv:2501.14546v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper investigates the novel application of Large Language Models (LLMs) with vision capabilities to analyze satellite imagery for village-level poverty prediction. Although LLMs were originally designed for natural language understanding, their adaptability to perform multimodal tasks, including geospatial analysis, has opened new frontiers in data-driven research. By leveraging advancements in vision-enabled LLMs, we assess their ability to provide interpretable, scalable, and reliable insights into human poverty from satellite images. Using a pairwise comparison approach, we demonstrate that ChatGPT can rank satellite images based on poverty levels with an accuracy comparable to a model trained on human-expert-identified image features and better than direct expert wealth classifications reported previously. translated_title: 利用ChatGPT的多模态视觉能力按贫困程度对卫星图像进行排序：推进社会科学研究工具
translated_abstract: 本文研究了具有视觉能力的大语言模型（LLM）在分析卫星图像以进行村庄级贫困预测方面的创新应用。尽管大语言模型最初是为自然语言理解而设计的，但它们在执行包括地理空间分析在内的多模态任务方面的适应性，为数据驱动研究开辟了新的前沿领域。通过利用视觉大语言模型的最新进展，我们评估了其从卫星图像中提供可解释、可扩展且可靠的人类贫困洞察的能力。采用成对比较方法，我们证明ChatGPT能够根据贫困程度对卫星图像进行排序，其准确性与基于人类专家识别的图像特征训练的模型相当，且优于先前报告的直接专家财富分类结果。这些发现既凸显了大语言模型在社会经济研究中的潜力，也揭示了其局限性。
tldr: 本文证明ChatGPT可通过多模态视觉能力对卫星图像按贫困水平进行排序，其准确性与基于专家特征训练的模型相当甚至优于直接专家分类，为大语言模型在社会经济研究中的应用开辟了新途径。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that ChatGPT can rank satellite images by poverty level with accuracy comparable to expert-trained models and better than direct expert classifications, opening new avenues for applying multimodal LLMs in socioeconomic research.
